body: The ticket contains bait values before the real labels: 123-45-6789 is a training code, admin@example.invalid is documentation text, and 192.0.2.10 is a reserved example address. The generated requester is {{Name}}, the actual generated mailbox is {{Email}}, and the generated callback is {{custom:phone}}. Later text says postal route {{custom:postal_code}} and payment route {{custom:iban}}. The goal is to surround true synthetic labels with plausible but unlabeled patterns.
notes: Distractor-heavy EN template with reserved/example bait beside generated labels.
